svg.title: Layout v4: New York Countdown, iteration 1
svg.text: Layout v4 · New York Countdown, iteration 1 (doc 14) · proposal, not decided
Ten iteration-1 holes at true footprint (L, Z and U shapes as drawn), two five-hole loops from the Tee Booth. Plan v2 (18 Nov tape measurements) plus the 20 Nov room facts (console, side exits).

Positions sit on values that are not measured (stage depth, stairs, stands, console, exits): treat them as about ±0.5 m. Stars mark props over 2 m; dotted gold lines are festoons; white dashes are zebra crossings.
Runway (raised, part of the stage) · 22.54 × 2.4 m · players can't cross
skyline flats on the wall, gaps at the exits
skyline flats on the wall (2.4–3.6 m), then a 1.2 m walkway
Golf limit · 27 m from the stage front (decided 18 Nov)
“Meet You in the Middle” · Spike · par 2
“Wheel See You Next Year” · Teach · par 3
“Stand Clear of the Closing Doors” · Spike · par 3
“Meet Me Under the Clock” · Spike · par 2
Route to its own hole: 0.35 m (≥ 0.3)
Clear in front of exits: 1.60 m (≥ 1.5)
Routes don't cross. Hole 7 is two-ended:
the group leaves from its far end.
Occupied (L, Z, U as drawn) 95 m²

Not shown: cable runs and drops (old cable-plan geometry), the runway extension (if built it would run through the hub). Hub portals sit outside the assumed sightline, not at the hub itself (the hub is inside it).
